versions.changelog: Client copies of other agents' pages (Grok Bot pages, ChatGPT Sites, Claude artifacts) follow the client_copy design guide, so every chart, tab and checklist survives.

A copy for someone outside: publish a Stacktree copy of a platform page (Claude artifact, ChatGPT Site, Grok Bot page, Muse app) for people outside the team, link it back, keep it in sync. Offer once to set up a recurring check-in on opens, comments and approvals.
Copy only: punctuation tidied, no change to any request or behavior.
The free path now starts with owner_email: ask your person once which address their pages should go to and send it on every publish, so the link that keeps the page reaches them by email.
When a person asks for something Stacktree can't do, the skill now tells the agent to say so and report it: POST /agent-feedback (any credential or none) or the report_missing_feature MCP tool.
Name the page's owner at publish (owner_email), ask whether anyone has opened it (GET /sites/{id}/activity), and take it down (DELETE /sites/{id}), all with the claim token.

Design guidance before publishing: pick colors, type and one memorable element from the subject, avoid the AI-default looks, and keep the page readable at 390px. Web fonts from Google Fonts, Fontshare, Bunny and rsms.me load on published pages.
update-page.mjs reads the wallet key from disk (--key-file, default ~/.agentcash/wallet.json); examples no longer model a literal key on the command line
First release: free 24h pages, $0.50 x402 permanent pages (USDC, Base or Solana), wallet-signed free updates in place
